The '''Farstey sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Farstey sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
